product_metadata.title: SlipX Solutions Adhesive Daisy Bath Treads Add Non-Slip Traction to Tubs, Showers, Pools, Boats, Stairs & More (6 Pieces, Reliable Grip, Purple)
features: Adhesive Daisy Bath Treads help prevent slips on all kinds of slippery surfaces.
Each package contains six 4 inch flower bath treads.
Easy to install and simple to clean.
Designed for use on smooth surfaces.
Some surface textures may affect adhesion. Not for use on refinished surfaces.
description: Improve traction in the bathtub, shower or other slippery spot with SlipX Solutions Adhesive Daisy Bath Treads. Made of high-quality vinyl, their playful design utilizes a textured surface pattern to provide peace of mind underfoot.
